rows: B.Arch at NITs, IIEST Shibpur and the three SPAs (Delhi, Bhopal, Vijayawada)
Reads it
JEE Main Paper 2A rank, counselled by JoSAA.
JEE Main 2027 Session 1 runs 22 to 30 January 2027, with Paper 2A inside the same windows.
About 600 B.Arch seats nationally, including IITs (secondary estimate). 45,452 sat Paper 2A in Session 1 of 2026, about 76 per seat.
Physics and Maths plus one more subject, at least 45% (Council of Architecture rule in the NATA brochure).
B.Planning (four years) at NITs and SPAs
Reads it
JEE Main Paper 2B rank, counselled by JoSAA.
Same January 2027 window as Paper 2A.
21,067 sat Paper 2B in Session 1 of 2026. We could not confirm the seat count.
Check the JoSAA eligibility line for Class 12 subjects before you register.
B.Arch at IIT Kharagpur and IIT Roorkee
Reads it
JEE Advanced qualification, then a pass in the pass-or-fail AAT (Architecture Aptitude Test). Seats go by JEE Advanced rank.
AAT 2026 was on 4 June 2026. JEE Advanced 2027 dates are not out.
Small intake inside the roughly 600 national B.Arch seats.
No AAT pass, no seat, even with a strong JEE Advanced rank.
BS (Research) at IISc Bengaluru
Reads it
JEE Advanced rank or IAT score. JEE Main and NEET are not on the selection page.
2026-27 applications ran 4 May to 7 June 2026. The 2027 cycle follows the same shape.
125 seats: 100 for Indian nationals, 20 extra seats for women, 5 for foreign nationals (official).
Physics, Chemistry and Maths at 60%. Class 12 passed in 2024, 2025 or 2026 was accepted this cycle.

items.heading: Name Your Situation
items.text: Name your situation. Use the A, B or C cards. A says what you hold. It decides which doors read it.

items.heading: Pick Two Doors and One
items.text: Pick two doors and one backup. One that fits how you work, one that fits your family budget, and one that costs little to keep alive, such as CUET for a BSc or IAT.

items.heading: Run One Small Test
items.text: Run one small test on each. Design: finish one drawing or observation set each week. Research: solve one real problem set and one short Python project. Uniform or sea: book the medical. Give each test as long as it genuinely takes.

items.heading: Write the Decision Down
items.text: Write the decision down. One page: what you chose, what it costs, what you gave up and the date you will review it. Show it to your family.

items.heading: If You Want to Leave
items.text: If you want to leave engineering and also use your rank, the pool is under 1% of the seats JoSAA sells. That is a small door, not a general exit.

items.heading: In 2026 Iisc Joined Josaa
items.text: In 2026 IISc joined JoSAA for four B.Tech programmes using JEE Advanced. Its BS (Research) is a separate route, so do not mix them up.

items.heading: Bs and Integrated Msc Seats
items.text: BS and integrated MSc seats exist at a few IITs, but we could not confirm seat counts from the pages we could read. Search the programme name in the official seat matrix.
